raw_output:
alias: 晚上十点关闭客厅灯并暂停音箱
description: 每晚十点，如果客厅窗户关闭，则暂停音箱并关闭客厅灯。
triggers:
  - platform: time
    at: '22:00'
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.living_window
    state: 'off'
actions:
  - service: media_player.media_pause
    target:
      entity_id: media_player.living_speaker
  - service: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_main
mode: single
